subject: Food Science
title: Pest Control
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Pest Control.

hook.text: A single mouse produces 70 droppings per day. In a food factory, that's 70 chances daily to contaminate product.

buildup.text: Rodents, insects, and birds carry Salmonella, E. coli, and parasites. Their droppings and body parts contaminate food directly.

discovery.text: Integrated Pest Management uses exclusion, sanitation, and monitoring before pesticides—targeted, not blanket spraying.

twist.text: Cockroaches survive a month without food and live on glue, grease, and soap. Elimination requires professional programs.

climax.text: A food factory pest audit failure can shut production immediately. A single live rodent found means mandatory investigation.

punchline.text: Pests carry disease and destroy trust. Prevent entry, and you prevent outbreaks.

quiz.question: What is Integrated Pest Management (IPM)?
options: A strategy prioritizing exclusion, sanitation, and monitoring before chemicals
